source_note: Separate Designer’s Choice index transcribed from supplied Summer/Fall 2026 catalog extractions. TOC category flags are index metadata only, not full availability or fit evidence. Index entries do not establish dimensions, compatibility, capacity, or current availability. Consult individual style tables and current price book.
source_conflicts: Tahoe 632, Colby 893 and Bennett 899 also occur in other supplied collection sources; this Designer’s Choice listing remains distinct.
Table-of-contents flags reproduce printed bullets and are not a complete list of orderable pieces; verify style eligibility and current price-book details.

The supplied Designer’s Choice extracts now cover model specifications on printed pages 1-29 and 32-33. The supplied excerpts jump from printed page 29 to page 32; no pages 30-31 content was provided. Colby 893 and Bennett 899 are indexed from their supplied P94 chair tables only; no other configurations are inferred.
prefix_definitions: High Leg Power Reclining Chair with Headrest
options: Adds left-side sitting mounted cradle and wireless remote instead of standard right-side remote on 29U styles.
Right-side sitting control panel with mounted cradle and wireless remote; standard on 29U styles.
Featherlite accent pillow upgrade: 95% duck feathers, 5% duck down in cotton down-proof ticking.
Adds hammered black nickel nailhead trim to select styles.
Changes standard leg design; designs vary by style.
Adds platinum nailhead trim to select styles.
Allows accent pillow fabric to be changed.
Adds brass nailhead trim to select styles.
Napkin-style arm-cap/headrest cover quantity choices with fabric orders.
Rechargeable lithium-ion battery pack for Designer’s Choice and duo styles; not available on lift chairs.
Upgrades standard ComfortCore seat cushion to ComfortDown Cushion with pocketed coils, high-resiliency foam, and feather/down/fiber blend jacket.
Upgrades standard ComfortCore seat cushions to ComfortCore with Contour Cushion.
Style option printed on Leo 024-30A; meaning not defined in supplied extraction.
